structure.unit: Care of Children Committed to Department

law.catch_line: Authority of superintendents with regard to application for operator's licenses and employment certificates
law.text: The superintendents of facilities established by the Department shall have the authority, commensurate with that of a parent in like cases, to give consent for those children placed in their respective facilities to (i) application for a motor vehicle operator's license and (ii) issuance of an employment certificate.
